title: AI provider configuration
description: `.ai/ai.yaml`: which provider to use and where its credential comes from. This file is committed, so it may name a credential *source* and must never carry a value — `env` and `keychain_entry` here are names, and `token` is deliberately absent from the vocabulary rather than merely discouraged, because a property that is forbidden is one no linter will eventually add.

default_provider.description: ID of the provider used when nothing else selects one. Must name a provider listed here; a dangling value is a finding rather than a silent fallback.

env.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the credential, never its value.

pricing.description: List prices used to report what a run cost, in USD per million tokens. A provider with no `pricing` reports cost as *unavailable*, never as zero. A configured `budget.max_run_usd` with no `pricing` here is a configuration error that stops the run before the call.

input_per_mtok.description: USD per million uncached input tokens.

cached_input_per_mtok.description: USD per million cached input tokens. Cached tokens are a subset of input tokens; when this is absent they are charged at the input price.

budget.description: Optional spending limit for `agent run`. A ceiling that cannot be checked against the selected provider's `pricing` stops the run rather than spending unbounded.

max_run_usd.description: The most one run may cost, in USD. The worst case for the request — its estimated input tokens plus the full output ceiling, at the provider's configured prices — is projected before the call; a projection above this stops the run before it is sent.

routing.description: Optional routing hints. No routing logic ships in the MVP, so anything here is inert until TASK-050 and is recorded to be ignored rather than honoured.
